output.revised_prompt:
Create a production-ready portrait 2:3 mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, designed to sit behind live reels and controls. Show one original, full-height, front-facing freestanding casino slot machine in an exact orthographic view, centered and symmetrical, filling approximately 96% of the canvas height and 94% of the width. High-end photorealistic 3D commercial product render, physically plausible casino hardware, smooth tactile materials, joyful vintage gaming-floor luxury.

The cabinet must have a clearly original silhouette structurally unlike any pearl-shell machine: a broad scalloped coin-fountain crown, layered satin-champagne-gold coin arcs, ivory body panels, warm muted-jade enamel accents, curved coin-stack side towers, delicate pearl strings, and small ruby gemstone lamps. Near the top, include a large blank deep-caramel marquee shaped like a wide flowing coin ribbon, with absolutely no text or symbols. Directly below it, add a small blank cream balance capsule. In the upper-middle, create one large completely empty warm-ivory five-reel aperture, a clean unobstructed horizontal display opening divided visually for a five-column live reel area, framed by a slightly squared rounded frame; the aperture itself must remain blank and uncluttered with no reels, icons, text, numbers, or imagery. Beneath it, add a narrow blank win plaque.

Build a forward-projecting physical console below the reel opening: two distinct blank bet-button housings on the left, a large central coin-like circular spin-button recess, and one blank auto-button housing on the right. Keep all button surfaces free of labels, letters, numbers, logos, and symbols. Form the lower pedestal from overlapping round coin bands with a central jade-and-pearl medallion, purely ornamental and without currency marks.

Place the cabinet in a softly blurred upscale luxury casino background with warm atmospheric bokeh, understated and non-distracting. Lighting: animated-looking warm incandescent bulbs, champagne reflections, gentle jade glow, celebratory coin sparkle, soft inviting ambience, premium physically based materials. Palette: satin champagne gold, deep caramel, warm ivory, pearl white, muted jade green, tiny restrained ruby accents. Preserve large clean centered live-UI zones and strong visual hierarchy.

Strict constraints: no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no currency symbols, no candy, no reel symbols, no content inside the reel aperture, and blank marquee and plaques. Original design only. Avoid shell-shaped or pearl-shell cabinet silhouettes, Chinese temples, dragons, palace grandeur, black-dominant styling, neon nightclub aesthetics, cheap yellow plastic, flat illustration, excessive filigree, and clutter over the live UI zones. Render the complete cabinet without cropping, straight-on with no perspective tilt.
